summary_zh: 今日泰國焦點集中在泰日產業合作：BOI與泰國工業聯合會積極爭取日本在電動車、半導體與汽車領域投資，並提出年產195萬輛的汽車振興策略，同時強調保護本土零件供應。另一方面，美國擬收緊高階晶片出口與轉運管制，泰國電子與車用零組件廠的合規風險隨之升高。
summary_en: Thailand-Japan cooperation dominated: BOI and FTI court Japanese EV, chip and auto investment, with a plan for 1.95M vehicles/year while protecting local parts suppliers. Meanwhile, planned US curbs on advanced chip exports and transshipment raise compliance risk for component makers.
